# graphiant_groups (Data Source)

Lists all Graphiant IAM groups in the enterprise.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_groups" "all" {}

output "group_names" {
  value = [for g in data.graphiant_groups.all.groups : g.name]
}
```
